lesson.title: Audio C: redesign of a town square

learning_objectives.en: Complete a note sheet and choose the right option despite distractors.
learning_objectives.vi: Điền ghi chú và chọn đáp án đúng khi có thông tin gây nhiễu.

strategies.en: Replay at natural speed, write the evidence phrase, then compare with the full transcript. Do not read the transcript before first attempt.
strategies.vi: Nghe tốc độ tự nhiên, ghi cụm bằng chứng, đối chiếu transcript sau lần làm đầu. Không đọc transcript ngay từ đầu.

mini_review.en: Can I explain why an earlier number was rejected?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có chỉ ra được vì sao một con số ban đầu bị thay đổi không?

mini_review.en: Can I explain each number or name from an audio transcript?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có thể tìm con số hoặc tên đúng trong transcript?

audios.title: U01_Listening_3
audios.transcript:
Speaker: Good evening, and thank you for coming to this information session about the redesign of Millbrook town square. I’ll explain what is changing, why, and what it means for you.
First, some background. The square was built in the nineteen-seventies mainly as a car park, and until last year it held around one hundred and twenty cars. Surveys showed that most of the spaces were empty after six in the evening, so the council decided the land could be used more effectively.
The main change is that the central area will become a pedestrian space. Cars will still be able to reach the shops along the northern edge, where we are keeping a short-stay car park with forty spaces. The rest of the square will be paved and planted.
Next, the market. At present, the weekly market takes place on Wednesdays. From the spring, it will move to Saturdays, because traders told us that is when most families are free. We are also adding a covered area so that the market can continue in bad weather.
Now, trees and water. We will plant thirty-five trees around the edge of the square, chosen because they provide shade without dropping too many leaves. In the centre there will be a shallow fountain that children can play in during the summer months.
Several of you have asked about seating. There will be benches facing both the fountain and the shops, and every bench will have a back and arm rests, which older residents requested during the consultation.
Finally, timing. Work starts in March and should take about nine months. During that period, the bus stop on the square will move temporarily to Station Road. We expect the square to reopen fully before the end of the year. Thank you – I’m happy to take questions.

audios.title: U01_Listening_4
audios.transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon, Cedar Homes. This is Alex speaking.
Caller: Hi. I'm calling about the two-bedroom flat advertised on Birch Street. Is it still available?
Agent: Yes. The first advertisement listed it for three hundred and sixty thousand pounds, but the owner reduced the asking price yesterday to three hundred and forty-five thousand.
Caller: Thank you. How large is the kitchen?
Agent: The kitchen measures three metres by two point four metres. Please don't confuse that with the living room, which is five metres by four metres.
Caller: And the bedrooms?
Agent: The main bedroom is four point two metres by three metres. The second bedroom is a little smaller: three point five by two point eight.
Caller: Is there a garden?
Agent: There's a small shared courtyard, but no private garden. You do get one parking space next to the west entrance.
Caller: Can I view the flat on Tuesday at four?
Agent: Tuesday is fully booked. We have Wednesday at four thirty or Thursday at six.
Caller: Wednesday at four thirty is perfect.
Agent: Great. Please ask for Maya when you arrive at reception, and bring your booking confirmation.
Caller: I'll do that. Thanks!

instruction.en: Play the supplied original practice MP3; complete notes without reading the transcript first.
instruction.vi: Nghe MP3 luyện tập mới được cung cấp, hoàn thành ghi chú; không đọc transcript trước.

questions.prompt_en: Original use of the square: a ______
questions.prompt_vi: Công dụng ban đầu của quảng trường: một ____
questions.explanation_en: The square was initially built mainly as a car park.
questions.explanation_vi: “built … mainly as a car park”.

questions.prompt_en: Number of cars the square held until last year: ______
questions.prompt_vi: Số xe có thể đỗ tại quảng trường trước năm ngoái: ____
questions.explanation_en: The old car park held approximately 120 cars, not the future 40 spaces.
questions.explanation_vi: “around one hundred and twenty cars”.

questions.prompt_en: Short-stay parking will remain along the ______ edge.
questions.prompt_vi: Bãi xe ngắn hạn còn lại ở rìa phía ____
questions.explanation_en: The short-stay car park will stay on the northern edge.
questions.explanation_vi: “the shops along the northern edge, where we are keeping a short-stay car park”.

questions.prompt_en: New market day: ______
questions.prompt_vi: Ngày họp chợ mới: ____
questions.explanation_en: The weekly market moves from Wednesday to Saturday in spring.
questions.explanation_vi: Hiện tại là Wednesday; từ mùa xuân chuyển sang Saturdays.

questions.prompt_en: Number of trees to be planted: ______
questions.prompt_vi: Số cây dự kiến trồng: ____
questions.explanation_en: The speaker specifies thirty-five new trees.
questions.explanation_vi: “thirty-five trees around the edge”.

questions.prompt_en: Children can play in a shallow ______ in summer.
questions.prompt_vi: Trẻ có thể chơi tại ____ nông vào mùa hè
questions.explanation_en: A shallow fountain is designed for children to play in during summer.
questions.explanation_vi: “a shallow fountain that children can play in”.

questions.prompt_en: Every bench will have a back and ______
questions.prompt_vi: Mọi ghế đều có tựa lưng và ____
questions.explanation_en: Each bench will have a back and arm rests.
questions.explanation_vi: “every bench will have a back and arm rests”.

questions.prompt_en: During the work, the bus stop will move to ______ Road.
questions.prompt_vi: Trong lúc thi công, trạm xe buýt tạm dời đến đường ____ Road
questions.explanation_en: The stop is temporarily moved to Station Road during construction.
questions.explanation_vi: “move temporarily to Station Road”.

instruction.en: Choose the final fact from the original practice transcripts; listen first.
instruction.vi: Nghe trước, chọn thông tin cuối cùng sau khi người nói sửa.

questions.prompt_en: Which day will the weekly market operate after the redesign?
questions.prompt_vi: Sau thiết kế lại, chợ họp thứ mấy?
questions.explanation_en: The speaker says the current day is Wednesday, but from spring the market moves to Saturdays.
questions.explanation_vi: Wednesday là ngày hiện tại, Saturday là ngày mới sau khi đổi.

questions.prompt_en: Where will the bus stop move temporarily?
questions.prompt_vi: Trạm xe buýt tạm chuyển đi đâu?
questions.explanation_en: The talk names Station Road as the temporary stop location.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài nói xác nhận Station Road là nơi chuyển tạm.

questions.prompt_en: What did the square mainly serve as in the past?
questions.prompt_vi: Trước đây quảng trường chủ yếu dùng làm gì?
questions.explanation_en: The speaker says it was built mainly as a car park.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói xác nhận quảng trường trước đây chủ yếu là bãi đỗ xe.

questions.prompt_en: The original car park had space for about how many cars?
questions.prompt_vi: Bãi đỗ xe ban đầu có khoảng bao nhiêu chỗ?
questions.explanation_en: 120 is the old capacity; 40 refers to the future short-stay car park; 35 to new trees.
questions.explanation_vi: 120 là sức chứa cũ; 40 là bãi xe mới, 35 là số cây.
